verses.translation: These are the names of the sons of Israel;

translations.ron: Iată acum fiii lui Israel: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Iuda, Isahar, Zabulon,
translations.grk: Ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ· Ῥουβὴν, Συμεὼν, Λευὶ, Ἰούδα, Ἰσσάχαρ, Ζαβουλὼν,

verses.translation: Ruben, Symeon, Levi, Juda, Issachar, Zabulon, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Nephthali, Gad, Aser.

translations.ron: Dan, Iosif, Veniamin, Neftali, Gad şi Aşer.
translations.grk: Δὰν, Ἰωσὴφ, Βενιαμὶν, Νεφθαλὶ, Γὰδ, Ἀσήρ.

verses.translation: The sons of Juda; Er, Aunan, Selom. These three were born to him of the daughter of Sava the Chananitish woman: and Er, the first-born of Juda, was wicked before the Lord, and he slew him.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iuda sunt: Ir, Onan şi Şela. Aceşti trei i s-au născut lui din fata unui canaanit anume Şua. Ir, întâiul născut al lui Iuda, a fost rău în ochii Domnului şi l-a omorât.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἰούδα, Ἢρ, Αὐνὰν, Σηλώμ· τρεῖς ἐγεννήθησαν αὐτῷ ἐκ τῆς θυγατρὸς Σαύας τῆς Χανανίτιδος· καὶ ἦν Ἢρ ὁ πρωτότοκος Ἰούδα πονηρὸς ἐναντίον Κυρίου, καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτόν·

verses.translation: And Thamar his daughter-in-law bore to him Phares, and Zara: all the sons of Juda were five.

translations.ron: Tamara, nora lui Iuda, i-a născut acestuia pe Fares şi pe Zara. Aşa că, de toţii, fiii lui Iuda au fost cinci.
translations.grk: Καὶ Θάμαρ ἡ νύμφη αὐτοῦ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Φαρὲς, καὶ τὸν Ζαρα· πάντες υἱοὶ Ἰούδα πέντε.

verses.translation: The sons of Phares, Esrom, and Jemuel.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Fares sunt Heţron şi Hamul.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Φαρὲς, Ἐσρὼμ, καὶ Ἰεμουήλ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Zara, Zambri, and Ætham, and Æmuan, and Calchal, and Darad, in all five.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Zara sunt: Zimri, Etan, Heman, Calcol şi Darda; cinci de toii.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ζαρὰ, Ζαμβρὶ, καὶ Αἰθὰμ, καὶ Αἰμουὰν, καὶ Καλχὰλ, καὶ Δαρὰδ, πάντες πέντε.

verses.translation: And the sons of Charmi; Achar the troubler of Israel, who was disobedient in the accursed thing.

translations.ron: Fiul lui Carmi este Acar, care a adus nenorocire asupra lui Israel, călcând jurământul.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Χαρμὶ, Ἀχὰρ ὁ ἐμποδοστάτης Ἰσραὴλ, ὃς ἠθέτησεν εἰς τὸ ἀνάθεμα.

verses.translation: And the sons of Ætham; Azarias,

translations.ron: Fiul lui Etan este Azaria.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Αἰθὰμ, Ἀζαρίας.

verses.translation: and the sons of Esrom who were born to him; Jerameel, and Aram, and Chaleb.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Heţron care i s-a născut sunt: Ierahmeel, Ram şi Chelubai (Caleb).
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἐσρὼμ οἳ ἐτέχθησαν αὐτῷ, ὁ Ἱεραμεὴλ, καὶ ὁ Ἀρὰμ, καὶ ὁ Χαλέβ.

verses.translation: And Aram begot Aminadab, and Aminadab begot Naasson, chief of the house of Juda.

translations.ron: Lui Ram însă i s-a născut Aminadab; lui Aminadab i s-a născut Naason, căpetenia fiilor lui Iuda.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἀρὰμ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἀμιναδὰβ, καὶ Ἀμιναδὰβ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ναασσὼν ἄρχοντα οἴκου Ἰούδα,

verses.translation: And Naasson begot Salmon, and Salmon begot Booz,

translations.ron: Lui Naason i s-a născut Salmon, lui Salmon i s-a născut Booz.
translations.grk: καὶ Ναασσὼν ἐγέννησε τὸν Σαλμὼν, καὶ Σαλμὼν ἐγέννησε τὸν Βοὸζ,

verses.translation: and Booz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jessæ.

translations.ron: Lui Booz i s-a născut Obed, lui Obed i s-a născut Iesei.
translations.grk: καὶ Βοὸζ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ὠβὴδ, καὶ Ὠβὴδ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἰεσσαὶ,

verses.translation: And Jessæ begot his first-born Eliab, Aminadab was the second, Samaa the third,

translations.ron: Lui Iesei i s-a născut Eliab, întâiul său născut, apoi al doilea, Aminadab, al treilea, Şama,
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰεσσαὶ ἐγέννησε τὸν πρωτότοκον αὐτοῦ τὸν Ἐλιὰβ, Ἀμιναδὰβ ὁ δεύτερος, Σαμαὰ ὁ τρίτος,

verses.translation: Nathanael the fourth, Zabdai the fifth,

translations.ron: Al patrulea, Natanael, al cincilea, Radai,
translations.grk: Ναθαναὴλ ὁ τέταρτος, Ζαβδαῒ ὁ πέμπτος,

verses.translation: Asam the sixth, David the seventh.

translations.ron: Al şaselea, Oţem şi al şaptelea, David.
translations.grk: Ἀσὰμ ὁ ἕκτος, Δαυὶδ ὁ ἕβδομος.

verses.translation: And their sister was Saruia, and another Abigaia: and the sons of Saruia were Abisa, and Joab, and Asael, three.

translations.ron: Surorile lor au fost Ţeruia şi Abigail. Fiii Ţeruiei au fost trei: Abişai, Ioab şi Asael.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡ ἀδελφὴ αὐτῶν Σαρουία, καὶ Ἀβιγαία· καὶ υἱοὶ Σαρουία, Ἀβισὰ, καὶ Ἰωὰβ, καὶ Ἀσαὴλ, τρεῖς.

verses.translation: And Abigaia bore Amessab: and the father of Amessab was Jothor the Ismaelite.

translations.ron: Abigail a născut pe Amasa; iar tatăl lui Amasa este Ieter Ismaelitul.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἀβειγαία ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἀμεσσάβ· καὶ πατὴρ Ἀμεσσὰβ Ἰοθὸρ ὁ Ἰσμαηλίτης.

verses.translation: And Chaleb the son of Esrom took Gazuba to wife, and Jerioth: and these were her sons; Jasar, and Subab, and Ardon.

translations.ron: Caleb, fiul lui Heţron, a avut de la Azuba, femeia sa, şi de la Ieriot următorii copii: Ieşer, Şobab şi Ardon.
translations.grk: Καὶ Χαλὲβ υἱὸς Ἐσρὼμ ἔλαβε τὴν Γαζουβὰ γυναῖκα, καὶ τὴν Ἰεριώθ· καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ αὐτῆς, Ἰασὰρ, καὶ Σουβὰβ, καὶ Ἀρδών.

verses.translation: And Gazuba died; and Chaleb took to himself Ephrath, and she bore to him Or.

translations.ron: Murind însă Azuba, Caleb şi-a luat de femeie pe Efrata şi aceasta i-a născut pe Hur.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέθανε Γαζουβὰ, καὶ ἔλαβεν ἑαυτῷ Χαλὲβ τὴν Ἐφρὰθ, καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Ὥρ.

verses.translation: And Or begot Uri, and Uri begot Beseleel.

translations.ron: Lui Hur i s-a născut Urie; lui Urie i s-a născut Beţaleel.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ὣρ ἐγέννησε τὸν Οὐρί· καὶ Οὐρὶ ἐγέννησε τὸν Βεσελεήλ.

verses.translation: And after this Esron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Galaad, and he took her when he was sixty-five years old; and she bore him Seruch.

translations.ron: După aceea Heţron a intrat la fata lui Machir, tatăl lui Galaad; şi a luat-o, fiind de şaizeci de ani şi ea i-a născut fiu pe Segub.
translations.grk: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσῆλθεν Ἐσρὼν πρὸς τὴν θυγατέρα Μαχὶρ πατρὸς Γαλαὰδ, καὶ αὐτὸς ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν, καὶ αὐτὸς ἑξηκονταπέντε ἐτῶν ἦν· καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Σερούχ.

verses.translation: And Seruch begot Jair, and he had twenty-three cities in Galaad.

translations.ron: Lui Segub i s-a născut Iair şi avea el atunci douăzeci şi trei de cetăţi în pământul Galaadului.
translations.grk: Καὶ Σεροὺχ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἰαΐρ. καὶ ἦσαν αὐτῷ εἴκοσι καὶ τρεῖς πόλεις ἐν τῇ Γαλαάδ.

verses.translation: And he took Gedsur and Aram, the towns of Jair from them; with Canath and its towns, sixty cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Galaad.

translations.ron: Dar Gheşurenii şi Sirienii le-au luat sălaşurile lui Iair cu Chenatul şi cetăţile care ţineau de el, în număr de şaizeci. Toate aceste cetăţi erau ale fiilor lui Machir, tatăl lui Galaad.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔλαβε Γεδσοὺρ καὶ Ἀρὰμ τὰς κώμας Ἰαῒρ ἐξ αὐτῶν, τὴν Κανὰθ καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς, ἑξήκοντα πόλεις· πᾶσαι αὗται υἱῶν Μαχὶρ πατρὸς Γαλαάδ.

verses.translation: And after the death of Esron, Chaleb came to Ephratha; and the wife of Esron was Abia; and she bore him Ascho the father of Thecoe.

translations.ron: După ce a murit Heţron, Caleb a intrat la Efrata, femeia lui Heţron, tatăl său, care a născut pe Aşur, tatăl lui Tecoa.
translations.grk: Καὶ μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν Ἐσρὼν, ἦλθε Χαλὲβ εἰς Ἐφραθά· καὶ ἡ γυνὴ Ἐσρὼν Ἀβιά· καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Ἀσχὼ πατέρα Θεκωέ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Jerameel the first-born of Esron were, the first-born Ram, and Banaa, and Aram, and Asan his brother.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ierahmeel, întâiul născut al lui Heţron, sunt: întâiul născut Ram, după el Vuna, Oren, Oţem şi Ahia.
translations.grk: καὶ ἦσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἱεραμεὴλ πρωτοτόκου Ἐσρὼν, ὁ πρωτότοκος Ῥὰμ, καὶ Βαναὰ, καὶ Ἀρὰμ, καὶ Ἀσὰν ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And Jerameel had another wife, and her name was Atara: she is the mother of Ozom.

translations.ron: Ierahmeel a mai avut şi altă femeie, cu numele Atara; aceasta este mama lui Onan.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦν γυνὴ ἑτέρα τῷ Ἱεραμεὴλ, καὶ ὄνομα αὐτῇ Ἀτάρα· αὕτη ἐστὶ μήτηρ Ὀζόμ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Ram the first-born of Jerameel were Maas, and Jamin, and Acor.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ram, întâiul născut al lui Ierahmeel, sunt: Maaţ, Iamin şi Echer.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ Ῥὰμ πρωτοτόκου Ἱεραμεὴλ, Μαὰς, καὶ Ἰαμὶν, καὶ Ἀκόρ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Ozom were, Samai, and Jadae: and the sons of Samai; Nadab, and Abisur.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Onan au fost: Şamai şi Iada. Fiii lui Şamai au fost: Nadab şi Abişur.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ Ὀζὸμ, Σαμαῒ, καὶ Ἰαδαέ· καὶ υἱοὶ Σαμαῒ, Ναδὰβ καὶ Ἀβισούρ.

verses.translation: And the name of the wife of Abisur was Abichaia, and she bore him Achabar, and Moel.

translations.ron: Numele femeii lui Abişur era Abihail şi aceasta i-a născut pe Ahban şi pe Molid.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὄνομα τῆς γυναικὸς Ἀβισοὺρ, Ἀβιχαία· καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Ἀχαβὰρ, καὶ τὸν Μωήλ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Nadab; Salad and Apphain; and Salad died without children.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Nadab au fost: Seled şi Efraim. Dar Seled a murit fără copii.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ναδὰβ, Σαλὰδ, καὶ Ἀπφαίν· καὶ ἀπέθανε Σαλὰδ οὐκ ἔχων τέκνα.

verses.translation: And the sons of Apphain, Isemiel; and the sons of Isemiel, Sosan; and the sons of Sosan, Dadai.

translations.ron: Fiul lui Efraim a fost Işei, iar fiul lui Işei a fost Şeşan; iar fiul lui Şeşan a fost Ahlai.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀπφαὶν, Ἰσεμιήλ· καὶ υἱοὶ Ἰσεμιὴλ, Σωσάν· καὶ υἱοὶ Σωσὰν, Δαδαί.

verses.translation: And the sons of Dadai, Achisamas, Jether, Jonathan: and Jether died childless.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iada, fratele lui Şamai, au fost Ieter şi Ionatan. Ieter a murit fără copii.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Δαδαὶ, Ἀχισαμὰς, Ἰεθὲρ, Ἰωνάθαν· καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ἰεθὲρ οὐκ ἔχων τέκνα.

verses.translation: And the sons of Jonathan; Phaleth, and Hozam. These were the sons of Jerameel.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ionatan au fost: Pelet şi Zaza. Aceştia sunt fiii lui Ierahmeel.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἰωνάθαν, Φαλὲθ, καὶ Ὁζάμ· οὗτοι ἦσαν υἱοὶ Ἱεραμεήλ.

verses.translation: And Sosan had no sons, but daughters. And Sosan had an Egyptian servant, and his name was Jochel.

translations.ron: Şeşan n-a avut fii, ci numai fiice. Şeşan avea un rob egiptean, cu numele Iarha.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἦσαν τῷ Σωσὰν υἱοὶ, ἀλλʼ ἢ θυγατέρες· καὶ τῷ Σωσὰν παῖς Αἰγύπτιος, καὶ ὄνομα αὐτῷ Ἰωχήλ.

verses.translation: And Sosan gave his daughter to Jochel his servant to wife; and she bore him Ethi.

translations.ron: Şeşan a dat pe o fată sa lui Iarha, robul său, de femeie şi ea a născut pe Atai.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκε Σωσὰν τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ τῷ Ἰωχὴλ παιδὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς γυναῖκα, καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Ἐθὶ,

verses.translation: And Ethi begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabed,

translations.ron: Atai a avut de fiu pe Natan, iar lui Natan i s-a născut Zabad.
translations.grk: καὶ Ἐθὶ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ναθὰν, καὶ Ναθὰν ἐγέννησε τὸν Ζαβὲδ,

verses.translation: and Zabed begot Aphamel, and Aphamel begot Obed.

translations.ron: Lui Zabad i s-a născut Eflal, iar lui Eflal i s-a născut Obed.
translations.grk: καὶ Ζαβὲδ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἀφαμὴλ, καὶ Ἀφαμὴλ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ὠβὴδ,

verses.translation: And Obed begot Jeu, and Jeu begot Azarias,

translations.ron: Lui Obed i s-a născut Iehu, iar lui Iehu i s-a născut Azaria.
translations.grk: καὶ Ὠβὴδ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἰηοὺ, καὶ Ἰηοὺ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἀζαρίαν,

verses.translation: and Azarias begot Chelles, and Chelles begot Eleasa,

translations.ron: Lui Azaria i s-a născut Heleţ, iar lui Heleţ i s-a născut Eleasa.
translations.grk: καὶ Ἀζαρίας ἐγέννησε τὸν Χελλὴς, καὶ Χελλὴς ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἐλεασὰ,

verses.translation: and Eleasa begot Sosomai, and Sosomai begot Salum,

translations.ron: Lui Eleasa i s-a născut Sismai, iar lui Sismai i s-a născut Şalum.
translations.grk: καὶ Ἐλεασὰ ἐγέννησε τὸν Σοσομαῒ, καὶ Σοσομαῒ ἐγέννησε τὸν Σαλοὺμ,

verses.translation: and Salum begot Jechemias, and Jechemias begot Elisama, and Elisama begot Ismael.

translations.ron: Şalum a avut de fiu pe Iecamia, iar Iecamia pe Elişama.
translations.grk: καὶ Σαλοὺμ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἰεχεμίαν, καὶ Ἰεχεμίας ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἐλισαμὰ, καὶ Ἐλισαμὰ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἰσμαήλ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Chaleb the brother of Jerameel were, Marisa his first-born, he is the father of Ziph:—and the sons of Marisa the father of Chebron.

translations.ron: Fiul lui Caleb, fratele lui Ierahmeel, era Meşa, întâiul său născut, tatăl lui Zif. Acesta a avut ca fiu pe Mareşa, tatăl lui Hebron.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Χαλὲβ ἀδελφοῦ Ἱεραμεὴλ, Μαρισὰ ὁ πρωτότοκος αὐτοῦ· οὗτος πατὴρ Ζίφ· καὶ υἱοὶ Μαρισὰ πατρὸς Χεβρών.

verses.translation: And the sons of Chebron; Core, and Thapphus, and Recom, and Samaa.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Hebron sunt: Core, Tapuah, Rechem şi Şema.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Χεβρὼν, Κορὲ, καὶ Θαπφοὺς, καὶ Ῥεκὸμ, καὶ Σαμαά.

verses.translation: And Samaa begot Raem the father of Jeclan: and Jeclan begot Samai.

translations.ron: Lui Şema i s-a născut Raham tatăl lui Iorchean, iar lui Rechem i s-a născut Şamai.
translations.grk: Καὶ Σαμαὰ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ῥαὲμ πατέρα Ἰεκλὰν, καὶ Ἰεκλὰν ἐγέννησε τὸν Σαμαΐ.

verses.translation: And his son was Maon: and Maon is the father of Bæthsur.

translations.ron: Fiul lui Şamai a fost Maon, iar Maon este tatăl lui Bet-Ţur.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Μαών· καὶ Μαὼν πατὴρ Βαιθσούρ.

verses.translation: And Gæpha the concubine of Chaleb bore Aram, and Mosa, and Gezue.

translations.ron: Şi Efa, concubina lui Caleb, a născut pe Haran, Moţa şi Gazez; iar Haran a fost tatăl lui Gazez.
translations.grk: Καὶ Γαιφὰ ἡ παλλακὴ Χαλὲβ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἀρὰμ, καὶ τὸν Μοσὰ, καὶ τὸν Γεζουέ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Addai were Ragem, and Joatham, and Sogar, and Phalec, and Gæpha, and Sagae.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iahdai sunt: Reghem, Iotan, Gheşan, Pelet, Efa şi Şaaf.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀδδαῒ, Ῥαγὲμ, καὶ Ἰωάθαμ, καὶ Σωγὰρ, καὶ Φαλὲκ, καὶ Γαιφὰ, καὶ Σαγαέ.

verses.translation: And Chaleb's concubine Mocha bore Saber, and Tharam.

translations.ron: Concubina lui Caleb, Maaca, a născut pe Şeber şi pe Tirhana;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡ παλλακὴ Χαλὲβ Μωχὰ ἐγέννησε τὸν Σαβὲρ, καὶ τὸν Θαράμ.

verses.translation: She bore also Sagae the father of Madmena, and Sau the father of Machabena, and the father of Gæbal: and the daughter of Chaleb was Ascha.

translations.ron: Tot ea a născut pe Şaaf, tatăl Madmanei, pe Şeva, tatăl Macbenei şi tatăl Ghibeii. Fiica lui Caleb este Acsa.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγέννησε Σαγαὲ πατέρα Μαδμηνὰ, καὶ τὸν Σαοὺ πατέρα Μαχαβηνὰ, καὶ πατέρα Γαιβάλ· καὶ θυγάτηρ Χαλὲβ, Ἀσχά.

verses.translation: These were the sons of Chaleb: the sons of Or the first-born of Ephratha; Sobal the father of Cariathiarim,

translations.ron: Aceştia au fost fiii lui Caleb. Fiul lui Hur, întâiul născut al Efratei a fost Şobal, tatăl lui Chiriat-Iearim;
translations.grk: Οὗτοι ἦσαν υἱοὶ Χαλέβ· υἱοὶ Ὢρ πρωτοτόκου Ἐφραθά· Σωβὰλ πατὴρ Καριαθιαρὶμ,

verses.translation: Salomon the father of Bætha, Lammon the father of Bæthalaem, and Arim the father of Bethgedor.

translations.ron: Salma, tatăl lui Betleem; Haref, tatăl lui Betgader.
translations.grk: Σαλωμὼν πατὴρ Βαιθὰ, Λαμμὼν πατὴρ Βαιθαλαὲμ, καὶ Ἀρὶμ πατὴρ Βεθγεδώρ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Sobal the father of Cariathiarim were Araa, and Æsi, and Ammanith,

translations.ron: Şobal, tatăl Chiriat-Iearimului a avut fii pe Haroe, Haţi şi Hamenuhot.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ τῷ Σωβὰλ πατρὶ Καριαθιαρὶμ Ἀραὰ, καὶ Αἰσὶ, καὶ Ἀμμανὶθ,

verses.translation: and Umasphaë, cities of Jair; Æthalim, and Miphithim, and Hesamathim, and Hemasaraim; from these went forth the Sarathæans, and the sons of Esthaam.

translations.ron: Familiile Chiriat-Iearimului sunt: Itrienii, Putienii, Şumatienii şi Mişraenii. Din acestea se trag Ţoreenii şi Eştauleenii.
translations.grk: καὶ Οὐμασφαὲ, πόλεις Ἰαῒρ, Αἰθαλὶμ, καὶ Μιφιθὶμ, καὶ Ἡσαμαθὶμ, καὶ Ἡμασαραΐμ· ἐκ τούτων ἐξήλθοσαν οἱ Σαραθαῖοι, καὶ υἱοὶ Ἐσθαάμ.

verses.translation: The sons of Salomon; Bæthalaem, the Netophathite, Ataroth of the house of Joab, and half of the family of Malathi, Esari.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Salma sunt: Betleem, Netofatiţii, Atrot-Bet-Ioab, jumătate din Manahteni, Ţoareni,
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Σαλωμὼν Βαιθαλαὲμ, ὁ Νετωφατὶ, Ἀταρὼθ οἴκου Ἰωὰβ, καὶ ἥμισυ τῆς Μαλαθὶ, Ἠσαρὶ·

verses.translation: The families of the scribes dwelling in Jabis; Thargathiim, and Samathiim, and Sochathim, these are the Kinæans that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

translations.ron: Familiile Soferiţilor, care trăiau în Iabeţ, Tiratiţii, Şimatiţii, Sucatiţii. Aceştia sunt Chineenii, care se trag din Hamat, tatăl casei lui Recab.
translations.grk: Πατριαὶ γραμματέων κατοικοῦντες ἐν Ἰάβις Θαργαθιῒμ, καὶ Σαμαθιῒμ, καὶ Σωχαθίμ· οὗτοι οἱ Κιναῖοι οἱ ἐλθόντες ἐξ Αἱμὰθ πατρὸς οἴκου Ῥηχάβ.
